conditions.title: A November heatwave, somehow
conditions.blurb: It's 81 degrees in November. Rooftops are packed, parks are full of people in coats they refuse to take off, and every iced coffee costs more.

effects.reason: Heatwave: every rooftop in Queens is at capacity

effects.note: 🥵 Half of Astoria is lying on the grass. The other half is telling them it's November.

conditions.title: The Steinway Street Fair
conditions.blurb: Twelve blocks of zeppoles, phone cases and a man selling one (1) very large rug. The food carts are doing their best numbers of the year, and charging like it.

effects.reason: Street fair crowds: the carts have a line and a new price

effects.note: 🎪 Volunteers are working the street fair. Bernie brought 4,000 stickers and no plan.

conditions.title: The grid is tired
conditions.blurb: The power company asked everyone to 'use less electricity, please.' Astoria's lounges took that personally and went dark for the evening.

effects.reason: Brownout: the lounges went dark until midnight

effects.note: 🔌 Sal is selling candles at the register. 'Ambience,' he says. 'Two dollars.'
